name: TACC Frontera
description: Data-only community profile for TACC Frontera. The Slurm queues close permanently on 2026-10-15.

site.access_note: A Frontera allocation and TACC MFA are required. TACC states that queues close permanently on 2026-10-15; after closure, filesystems remain accessible for data transfer.

access.access_note: Use the TACC username, password, and configured TACC MFA token. No credential is stored by this package.

project.label: TACC project
project.help: Use a project value only when required by the assigned allocation.

account.label: TACC allocation
account.help: Use an allocation assigned to this TACC account. Never substitute a guessed or personal value.

scheduler_hints.queue_notes: TACC states that Frontera queues close permanently on 2026-10-15. Do not submit jobs after closure. Before that date, verify live queue availability with TACC guidance; this profile intentionally lists no fixed partitions.
scheduler_hints.account_notes: Use the TACC allocation assigned to the user. No allocation identifier is bundled.

software.setup_notes: The TACC guide recommends login nodes for file management, compilation, and data movement; computation belongs in batch or interactive jobs while queues are available.

policy.cleanup_note: TACC documents regular backups and no purge for HOME.
TACC documents a shared 1 TB and 3,000,000-file allowance across TACC systems; WORK is not backed up or purged.
Files not accessed for more than 10 days are subject to purge. TACC assigns users to scratch2 or scratch3; scratch1 has been decommissioned.
